heard: One of the brightest stars in our sky went dark. Orion's red shoulder, the supergiant Betelgeuse, suddenly lost its brilliance. It plummeted from the top 10 brightest night objects. If it replaced our sun, it would swallow Jupiter. Many fear the massive star was about to explode. But the star wasn't dying. It was actually burping. A massive bubble of plasma erupted from its surface. It cooled into dust and blocked its own light. The giant had hidden itself behind its own outburst. Even the brightest stars in our sky can go dark.
